description:
THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE SYNOPSIZING AN UPCOMING COMPETITIVE SOLICITATION SATISFYING THE REQUIREMENTS OF FAR 5.201 AND 5.203   AN REQUEST FOR QUOTATION WILL BE POSTED ON OR ABOUT MARCH 18, 2026

Remote Tele Radiology Physician Services, Albany VA Medical Center: Procurement Number: 36C24226Q0259

The Albany VA Medical Center (VAMC) will be posting a solicitation to provide remote Tele Radiology services. 
All work will be accomplished remotely as indicated in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). 
The NAICS code for this procurement is 621512 with a small business size standard of $19.0 million. This project is 100% set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses.
